name: bottle weighted squatting alternate waves
description: A squat with arms swinging like waves while holding bottles. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
